brief:
Israel has barred British journalist Secunder Kermani from entering the country, Middle East Eye reported. The exclusion reflects a broader tightening of restrictions on foreign reporters operating in Israeli territory.

Kermani's case is part of a widening crackdown that has included the killing of Palestinian journalists, according to the outlet. The specifics of Israel's stated reasons for barring Kermani were not detailed in the initial report.
dek: British journalist Secunder Kermani barred from Israel amid widening press crackdown Submitted by Elis Gjevori on Sun, 10/11/2026 - 22:30 Kermani’s exclusion comes as Israel tightens restrictions on foreign reporters and kills Palestinian journalists Channel…
title: Israel bars British journalist Secunder Kermani in widening press crackdown
